messages.name: get_code_snippet

messages.content:
The `FastDateFormat.getDateInstance(int style, Locale locale)` method creates a `FastDateFormat` instance with the specified style and locale. The `FastDateFormat` class has a constructor that takes a pattern, a `TimeZone`, and a `Locale`. The constructor ensures that the `Locale` is not null and defaults to the system default if it is.

In the failing test `test_changeDefault_Locale_DateInstance()`, the test changes the default locale and then creates `FastDateFormat` instances with different styles using `FastDateFormat.getDateInstance(FastDateFormat.FULL, Locale.GERMANY)` and `FastDateFormat.getDateInstance(FastDateFormat.FULL)`. It then changes the default locale again and creates another `FastDateFormat` instance using `FastDateFormat.getDateInstance(FastDateFormat.FULL)`.

The bug report mentions that `FastDateFormat.getDateInstance()` creates a HashMap key using the locale but if the locale is null, the stored object is created using the current default locale. If the locale is subsequently changed, then the wrong locale is applied.

Based on this information, the bug likely occurs because the `FastDateFormat` instances created in the test are using the default locale at the time of creation and not updating to reflect the changes in the default locale during the test.

To fix this issue, the `FastDateFormat` class should update the locale of the instances whenever the default locale changes.

Next, I will provide the methods to be fixed.
```
org.apache.commons.lang.time.FastDateFormat.FastDateFormat(java.lang.String, java.util.TimeZone, java.util.Locale)
org.apache.commons.lang.time.FastDateFormat.getDateInstance(int, java.util.Locale)
```

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
